cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.zh: 現在到了重要分岔點，有兩條路線。

cues.en: Now, don't worry, these two paths just depend on your past experience.
cues.zh: 不用擔心，只取決於過去經驗。

cues.en: At the end of the course, you're still going to end up in the same location with the same knowledge.
cues.zh: 課程最後，仍會到相同終點，具備相同知識。

cues.en: But we want to make sure that this course is inclusive for everybody, and that is in order for us to continue.
cues.zh: 希望每個人都能學，所以繼續之前，

cues.en: We need to know a programming language, and specifically Python, because Python is used all over data science.
cues.zh: 必須懂一種程式語言，具體是 Python，因為資料科學到處都用它。

cues.en: It's a mandatory requirement, so we need to learn it.
cues.zh: 這是必要條件，所以得學。

cues.en: Now for some of you.
cues.zh: 有些人，

cues.en: You already know Python, right?
cues.zh: 已經懂 Python，對吧？

cues.en: For those that know Python, you can just keep continuing with the next lecture because starting from the next lecture, we're going to assume that you know how to program in Python.
cues.zh: 懂的人直接繼續下一堂，因為從下一堂起，會假設你已會用 Python 寫程式。

cues.en: The other path is for people that don't know Python.
cues.zh: 另一條適合不懂 Python 的人。

cues.en: Whether you're new to programming or maybe know another language but aren't so familiar with Python, well, we have a second path where we teach you Python from scratch.
cues.zh: 不管是程式新手，或會其他語言但不熟 Python，都有第二條路，從零學 Python。

cues.en: For those people, you'll have to go to the bottom of the course in the course outline and start the python section.
cues.zh: 請到課程大綱最下面，開始 Python 章節。

cues.en: And once you're done that Python section, come back to this lecture and then continue on with the course.
cues.zh: 完成後，再回到這堂，繼續課程。

cues.en: I promise you, it's not as intimidating as you think.
cues.zh: 我保證沒你想的可怕。

cues.en: And you're going to learn Python enough to get hired now.
cues.zh: 會學到足以求職的 Python。

cues.en: You might be asking yourself, Andre, why do we even need Python?
cues.zh: 你可能會問，Andrei，為什麼一定要 Python？

cues.en: All this stuff you've been talking about sounds a lot like just data that, well, we can just use Excel and Excel sheets to create graphs and don't we have Excel for this?
cues.zh: 前面聽起來不就是資料嗎？用 Excel 試算表繪圖不就好，已經有 Excel 了啊？

cues.en: And having businesses been using Excel successfully for the past decades now, even though Excel is
cues.zh: 企業過去幾十年，不也一直成功使用 Excel？雖然 Excel，

cues.en: great, there are some areas that make a programming language like Python a lot better for certain types of data science and data analysis.
cues.zh: 很好，但某些資料科學與分析工作，Python 這種語言更合適。

cues.en: So trust me on this one.
cues.zh: 這點請相信我。

cues.en: You need to know Python because unlike Excel, where you can just have a visual representation and drag and drop cells and play things around.
cues.zh: 需要懂 Python；Excel 可以視覺化呈現、拖放儲存格和調整內容。

cues.en: Well, with Python, we have certain benefits, like the ability to work with almost any kind of data.
cues.zh: Python 則有其他優點，像能處理幾乎任何資料。

cues.en: You can automate repetitive tasks and make things easier.
cues.zh: 能自動化重複工作，讓事情更容易。

cues.en: It's a lot faster when you start working with larger and larger amounts of data.
cues.zh: 資料量越來越大時，速度快得多。

cues.en: It has advanced statistics and machine learning capabilities that we wouldn't get with Excel.
cues.zh: 有 Excel 沒有的進階統計與機器學習能力。

cues.en: And also advanced data visualizations.
cues.zh: 也有進階資料視覺化。

cues.en: So we can just make things beyond just general graphs that you might find in Excel.
cues.zh: 可以超越 Excel 常見的一般圖表。

cues.en: But more importantly, with Python, you can run Python anywhere.
cues.zh: 更重要的是，Python 能在各種地方執行。

cues.en: You don't need a certain type of operating system or a certain type of computer.
cues.zh: 不需要特定作業系統或電腦。

cues.en: You can run your data science projects and machine learning projects with Python.
cues.zh: 可以用 Python 執行資料科學與機器學習專案。

cues.en: So yes, you have to know Python and I've said Python a million times in this video.
cues.zh: 所以確實需要懂 Python，這支影片說了不知道多少次。

cues.zh: 有兩個選擇。

cues.en: Either you know, Python and keep going with the course or you don't know Python.
cues.zh: 已經懂 Python 就繼續，或還不懂。

cues.en: So you're going to jump to the Python section and come back to this video.
cues.zh: 那就先跳到 Python 章節，再回來這支影片。

cues.zh: 好，兩條路線。

cues.en: Let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: We're all going to end up in the same location.
cues.zh: 最後都會到相同地方。

cues.zh: 下一堂見。
